etym.s: [cf. Gk. ὀμιχεῖν, Lat. mingere, mejere; Slav. migla; Lith. mė́żti, Angl.Sax. mîgan; Germ. Mist.]

spans.s: 2. मि॑ह् f. mist, fog, downpour of water (also pl.; मिहो॑ न॑पात्, the demon of the mist), RV.
(accord. to Uṇ. i, 52 fr. √ 1. मिह्, but prob. the Persian مهر) the sun, MBh.; Kāv. &c. (L. also ‘a cloud; wind; the moon; a sage’)
N. of an author (= वराह-म्˚), Cat.
मिहिर—कुल m. N. of a prince, Rājat.
मिहिर—दत्त m. N. of a man, ib.,
मिहिर—पुर n. N. of a city (built by Mihira-kula), ib.
मिहिर—रति m. N. of a man, Cat.
N. of a queen of Ravi-ṣeṇa, Inscr.
N. of a temple (built by Mihirakula), Rājat.
N. of a city in the south of India, Pañcat. (cf. महिलारोप्य).
